questions.question:
**The question below consists of a set of labelled sentences. Out of the four options given, select the most logical order of the sentences to form a coherent paragraph.**

Leadership and

A - team-building skills deepened

B - for relationships

C - a sense of value
questions.solution:
The correct** answer is ACB.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• 'A' is the **first part** as the subject** 'team-building skills' (introduction of another subject) fits correctly after 'and.' **
 
• 'C' follows 'A' as** it states what deepened (a sense of value).**
 
• 'B' **completes** the sentence by conveying** 'a sense of value for what' (for relationships).**

 

**Correct sentence**__**:* '****Leadership and team-building skills deepened a sense of value for relationships.' *

questions.question:
**In the following question, out of the four alternatives, select the alternative which will improve the bracketed part of the sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select "no improvement".**

My daughter (comes running) as fast as her little feet can take her while her eyes sparkle vivaciously.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **No improvement.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence is structured in simple present tense thus the verbs 'comes running' fit here correctly.
 
• **'Come running'** is an idiom that means** 'to run to someone'.**
 
 
• Ex.* The dog came running when she called it.*
 
 
 
• We need to change the main verb **'come' **as per the sentence we use. In the simple present, we use '**s'** or '**es'** to the root word. 
 
• Hence, the use of **'comes running' is correct in the given sentence. **
 
• The tense forms in the options are not correct and they are grammatically wrong. 

 

**Correct sentence__: '***My daughter (comes running) as fast as her little feet can take her while her eyes sparkle vivaciously.'*

questions.solution:

• In the given sentence from the verbs **tried **and **slowed** we can say the sentence is structured in the past tense.

 ** 

**Correct sentence:__ *'****As he tried harder, his steps slowed, his senses **were **activated.'*

questions.question: always be verified _________ reference to one's own.​
questions.solution:
The correct answer is by.

***__Key Points__**

• The correct preposition here is **'by' as something is verified 'by' **a **particular method. **
 
• **By** **-** **Identifying the agent performing an action**. indicating the means of achieving something.
 
 
• *Ex. He was hit by a car.*
 
 
 
• Hence 'by' should be used in the given space. 

 

Correct sentence__: '**While the text should be thoroughly mastered, its statements should __always be verified **by** reference to one's own__ experience, and observation of others.'*

****__Additional Information__***

• Ex. *Down to the shops. *
 
 
 
• Approaching or reaching (a particular condition).
 
 
• Ex. *It turned out to be amazement to joy *
 
 
 
• Identifying the person or thing affected by or receiving something. 
 
 
• Ex.* You were rude to him *
 
 
 
• Identifying a particular relationship between one person and another. 
 
 
• Ex. *He is married to her. *

• ​Ex. *He was waiting for a good opportunity. *

questions.question: material is to be ___________ in ourselves
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **found. **

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• The verb “To be” most frequently **works in conjunction with another verb, **Occasionally, though, the verb will stand by itself, alone, in a sentence. 
 
• The construction to be + the past participle is a passive infinitive.
 
• An infinitive construction in which the agent (or performer of the action) either appears in a prepositional phrase following the verb or is not identified at all.
 
• The passive infinitive is made up of the marker **to + be + a past participle** (also known as the -en form):
 
 
• Ex. *The case is to be decided by a judge.*
 
 
 
• Hence **'Found'** should be used in the given space.

 

**Correct sentence:__* ****'The laboratory __material is to be **found** ourselves__.'*

questions.question:
**A sentence has been given in Direct/Indirect Speech. Out of the four given alternatives, select the one which best expresses the same sentence in Indirect/ Direct Speech.**

Ram said, "I have cleared the clutter."

options.text: Ram told that he cleared the clutter.
Ram says that he cleared the clutter.
Ram said that he had cleared the clutter.
The clutter was cleared by Ram

questions.solution:
The correct answer is** Ram said that he had cleared the clutter. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is in the **direct speech** we **need to convert it into Indirect speech. **
 
• In the **indirect speech** the** correct pronoun** and the **correct tense need to be used.**
 
• **The present perfect tense** in direct speech **becomes past perfect in indirect speech.**
 
• The word** 'said' does not need a change **and option 3 is the correct answer.

 

Hence, the correct answer is ***'Ram said that he had cleared the clutter.'***
